correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed column potentials from the Laplacian. A unit common-edge source is supported on the common antisymmetric mode of eigenvalue T; a private internal source has clique eigenvalue a+2 or b+2. For the mixed source δ_u−δ_x, split off (δ_u−δ_v)/2: the symmetric remainder has potentials c/2 on both common vertices and on W, −c on x and zero on the other vertices of U, where c=1/(a+2). The antisymmetric part adds ±1/(2T) on u,v. Summing absolute drops gives (2a+1)c+(b+1)/T, with diagonal (3c+1/T)/2, plus the swapped column. For each source, the displayed diagonal is strictly between zero and one; replacing Q by I−Q changes the absolute column sum by 1−2Q_ee. This recovers all five columns and both norms by symmetry. Checked the elimination of internal columns, the two factorizations and the common-edge comparison B(a,b)−(3−6/T)=b(a−4)/((a+2)T). In particular the common cycle column wins strictly if both sizes are <4, ties if the larger size is 4 and cannot win once either exceeds 4. At a=2, b≥5 the maxima strictly separate. The positive deficits 3/(a+2)+(a+1)/T and 6/(a+2)+(a+2)/T show strict upper bounds and convergence along (k,k²). The frozen exact-rational checker and expected-output description were inspected, not executed; the unrestricted conclusion follows from the exact calculation.
residual_risks: Only the canonical orthogonal projections on the finite unweighted shared-edge graphs are determined; no minimum over projections or other p-norms is certified.

A cut column is the electrical unit dipole response, and its absolute sum is total absolute edge current regardless of orientation.

value.rationale: Identifying two cliques along their smallest nontrivial interface is a natural graph composition, and the norm measures maximal electrical response to an edge load. The exact table shows how the interface alters endpoint amplification, gives distinct thresholds and an infinite strict separation between the maximizing edge types, and determines sharp bounds not inherited from the standalone complete graphs. This supplies an explicit benchmark for composition, beyond another numerical example of opposite maximizers.
residual_risks: No claim about arbitrary clique sums, weighted conductances or optimal projection constants.
